aforecapital-gamma-app:ashbyhq:c30e2984-.description: ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be the operational backbone for Gamma's three co-founders: the CEO, CPO, and CTO, helping them do their best work. This means owning their calendars, shaping how they communicate internally, and making sure the right things get their attention at the right time. You'll develop a deep understanding of each co-founder's priorities and working style, then use that context to protect their time, prepare them for what's ahead, and keep things moving when they're heads-down building. You'll plan and execute internal events and team gatherings that reflect Gamma's creative culture, draft and coordinate internal communications on behalf of leadership, and build the systems and workflows that keep three busy executives organized and aligned. We're looking for someone who's proactive, polished, and excited to use AI tools to work smarter. If you treat automation as a superpower and see upward management as a craft, this role was built for you. Our team has a strong in-office culture and works in person 4–5 days per week in San Francisco. We love working together to stay creative and connected, with flexibility to work from home when focus matters most. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own complex, interconnected calendars for Gamma's CEO, CPO, and CTO, actively managing priorities, resolving conflicts, and ensuring each leader's time reflects what matters most - Drive upward management by tracking commitments, surfacing blockers, and keeping executives informed, prepared, and on track - Plan and execute team events, company offsites, and internal gatherings from concept through coordination, with a high bar for experience and detail - Draft, edit, and coordinate internal communications on behalf of leadership, ensuring the right message reaches the right people at the right time - Build and maintain internal workflows using AI tools and automation platforms like Claude and Zapier to reduce friction and create leverage across the executive team - Serve as a trusted point of contact for cross-functional teams, helping facilitate decisions and follow-through on behalf of leadership WHAT YOU'LL BRING - At least 3 years of experience supporting senior executives in a fast-paced environment, with a strong track record in scheduling, communications, and event planning - A genuine talent for upward management: you know how to keep busy leaders organized, informed, and accountable without being asked twice - Excitement for AI-powered tools and workflow automation. You've built systems with Claude, Zapier, or similar platforms, and you're always looking for ways to create more leverage - Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly and in someone else's voice when needed - High EQ and a natural ability to build trust across all levels of an organization. - Strong discretion and sound judgment when handling sensitive information and confidential decisions - High taste and a sharp eye for quality across everything you touch. Whether it's a dinner reservation, a company offsite, a swag order, or an external communication, you bring a sense of craft and intention that makes Gamma look and feel like the caliber of company it is - Experience planning high-quality events or offsites, with sharp attention to logistics and the human details that make them memorable COMPENSATION RANGE: The base salary for this full-time position, which spans multiple internal levels depending on qualifications, ranges between $85K - $155K plus benefits & equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including but not limited to experience and expertise in the requirements listed above. If you're interested in this role but you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway! We're always excited about meeting great people.

Our partner is looking for a Mobile Game Developer based in France. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Unity developer to build engaging mobile games for a global player audience. You’ll contribute across the full game development lifecycle, from rapid prototyping through live operations and continuous improvement. The role combines strong game engineering fundamentals with an AI-first approach to development and problem solving. You’ll work closely with designers, artists, producers, backend engineers, and QA to create polished multiplayer experiences. Your work will span gameplay systems, UI, performance optimization, networking, automation, and platform-specific challenges. You’ll also help shape engineering standards and explore new AI-powered workflows that make development faster without compromising quality. This is an ideal environment for a creative, technically strong developer who enjoys ownership, experimentation, and building games at scale. Develop and maintain high-quality mobile games in Unity for iOS and Android platforms. Build gameplay systems, UI, animations, VFX, audio features, and live-operations functionality using clean and scalable C# code. Use AI-powered development tools to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, documentation, and rapid prototyping while maintaining production-quality standards. Critically review and validate AI-generated code before integrating it into production systems. Collaborate with designers, producers, artists, backend engineers, and QA to deliver polished and engaging player experiences. Prototype gameplay mechanics quickly, gather feedback, and iterate on features throughout development. Optimize CPU, GPU, memory, battery usage, and overall performance across a broad range of mobile devices using Unity profiling tools. Diagnose and resolve complex gameplay, networking, memory, and platform-specific issues. Implement and maintain integrations involving REST APIs, WebSockets, and multiplayer networking. Contribute to CI/CD processes, build automation, deployment pipelines, reusable systems, and internal development tools. Participate in code reviews and help establish strong engineering standards and development practices. Evaluate emerging AI tools and workflows that can improve development velocity while considering quality, security, and technical limitations. Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily standups, and iterative development cycles. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Interactive Media, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. 5+ years of professional experience developing mobile games with Unity. At least two shipped mobile game titles. Excellent proficiency in C# and strong software engineering fundamentals. Strong knowledge of Unity architecture, UI Toolkit or uGUI, prefabs, asset management, animation, audio, and scene management. Experience developing both 2D and 3D mobile games. Proven experience optimizing mobile applications across CPU, GPU, memory, and battery performance. Experience with REST APIs, WebSockets, multiplayer systems, or related networked game technologies. Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Experience working within Agile development environments. Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and creative disciplines. Comfortable using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Unity AI, or similar tools. Ability to write effective prompts for technical development tasks and use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, documentation, testing, and refactoring. Strong judgment when reviewing AI-generated output, with the ability to test, improve, and validate solutions rather than relying on them without verification. Understanding of the limitations,

southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:04e88d68-f.title: Product Manager
southparkcommons-town:ashbyhq:04e88d68-f.description: ABOUT TOWN Town is an AI-powered assistant that connects to your tools to do real work on your behalf — triaging your inbox, drafting in your voice, managing your schedule, and running workflows across everything you use. It knows you deeply and gets sharper over time. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a foundational Product Manager to join our small & mighty product team. You’ll partner closely with our existing PM and report directly into our co-founder and CPO Tony Vincent. https://www.linkedin.com/in/hellotonyv/ This is a central, high-leverage & high-visibility role on a tenured, lean team. You won't be a siloed PM shepherding a single feature spec inside a big org. You’ll own central parts of our product, bringing analytical, data-driven rigor to the product motion: setting cadence, driving process (but never just for process-sake!), and owning the unglamorous, operational work that gets product shipped. WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON - Push the frontier of what AI can do for users. Turn fast-moving model and agent capabilities into shipped product. You'll do this by bringing an AI-native workflow to your own craft, prototyping, spec'ing, and shipping faster than PMs ever previously thought possible. - Shape the core product experience. Drive improvements to the workflows our customers rely on most. - Build high-impact product bets from zero to launch. Lead new experiences that continue to differentiate and deepen our moat. - Define the future of team collaboration. Go deep with customers, study the market, and turn insights into a clear roadmap for how teams work together in the product. - Tackle complex product problems with simplicity. Help translate technically sophisticated systems into intuitive experiences for non-technical users. - Use data to make the product smarter. Partner closely with engineering, growth and bizops to understand user behavior, improve activation, and inform what the product should do next. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU... - Operate at a staff or senior level. You thrive in collaborative environments where you’re trusted to work independently, and you particularly enjoy working with top 1% talent who ups your game when you collaborate with them. - Are a low-ego generalist. You’re happy to take on the unglamorous work, and energized by making the entire system better rather than owning a glamorous slice of it. - Are AI-fluent and AI-curious. You don't have to be the most technical person in the room, but you’re already leveraging AI to make you a better, faster PM and you’re excited about where the industry is going - Bring customer empathy to everything you do. You enjoy interfacing with customers, and you use your strong active listening skills to get to the root of a customer’s feedback. - Think from first principles in undefined, fast-moving situations. You’ve been historically successful and happy in roles that aren’t fully defined/scoped. You have good taste and high horsepower and you’re comfortable leaning into these attributes vs fitting into a textbook PM mold. - Are excited about working in-person in SF, five days a week. LOCATION San Francisco, CA — five days a week in-person at our Financial District office (near Montgomery BART/Muni stop).

Our model is designed to empower providers with the resources, collaboration, and support they need to thrive. Backed by a dedicated operational team, our clinicians can focus on what matters most, delivering excellent patient outcomes and shaping the future of urology together. Academic Urology & Urogynecology of Arizona (AUUA) – Peoria, AZ Discover the advantages of Advanced Independent Practice - AUUA - powered by Urology Alliance. As a member of Urology Alliance (UA), AUUA is supported by the nation’s leading patient-focused, excellence-driven gastroenterology network that is physician-led. This partnership empowers AUUA to deliver superior, individualized patient care by leveraging Urology Alliance’s robust, world-class business and organizational support, ensuring our clinicians can focus on what they do best – providing top-notch care in a successful and dynamic private practice setting. General Responsibilities: Perform complete evaluations on patients of all ages Order and interpret lab work, imaging, and other diagnostic studies Establish working diagnoses and develop treatment plans in collaboration with urologists Implement therapeutic interventions and provide appropriate follow-up care Refer to the supervising urologist or specialists as needed Other duties as assigned Key Responsibilities: Sees new and follow-up patients and provides problem-oriented intervention for their urological conditions Assists in care, treatment, and follow-up as needed Perform and/or assists in-office procedures, including transrectal ultrasound (TRUS) volume studies, cystoscopies, post-void residual (PVRs) evaluations, difficult catheterizations, post-op voiding trials, and other necessary procedures Orders and interprets lab, x-ray, special studies, and clinical procedures, and provides appropriate care and follow-up Provides phone/video consultation for patient complaints and prescription refills Performs on-call duties for urology Evaluates, screens, and counsels’ patients on health maintenance and promotes utilization of community resources Education & Experience Requirements: Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) or PA degree from an accredited program Active and valid state medical license DEA/DPS license Urology experience preferred but not required Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) Strong leadership and team collaboration skills Who is Urology Alliance? At Urology Alliance, our patients are at the center of everything we do. We are committed to providing the highest standard of urological care and delivering an exceptional patient experience at every step. Our clinicians have access to a broad spectrum of advanced urologic expertise, innovative treatment options, clinical trials, and cutting-edge research across the country. This shared knowledge and collaboration empower our providers to achieve outcomes that set the standard in urological medicine. #LI-KG1 Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:55b17b7f-530.description: About the Role We are looking for detail-oriented Trainers to support an AI data annotation project. In this role, you will review pre-seeded questions paired with images and provide accurate "golden" answers based on what you observe in the image. This is a task-based, remote-friendly opportunity ideal for individuals who are meticulous, and able to follow detailed instructions consistently. What You'll Do Review a pre-seeded question along with an accompanying image (e.g., "What is the title of the Excel file based on what you see in the image?")

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:ec61d2f7-34a.title: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) Content Reviewer
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:ec61d2f7-34a.description: OVERVIEW We are seeking a Content Reviewer to evaluate and refine AI-generated summaries for locations on a maps product. These summaries are automatically generated for places such as restaurants, parks, and landmarks and require localization and adjustments to ensure accuracy, cultural relevance, and naturalness. As a Reviewer, you will leverage your expertise in writing structure, content, tone, and perspective to ensure summaries are consistent, coherent, and aligned with the required guidelines. You will also conduct research to verify information and refine content for clarity and readability. This freelance role offers flexibility, with task volumes varying based on project needs. If you have a strong language background and enjoy creating culturally accurate content, we’d love to have you on board as a language expert! Project Details Schedule: Flexible workload without a fixed work commitment This is a freelance opportunity; the workload is based on project needs. Employment Type: Freelance/Independent Contract Location: Remote Language: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) Pay Rate: $24/hour
responsibilities: Review guidelines and training content to ensure adherence to the required structure, tone, and style specific to the Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) locale.
Occasionally provide feedback or rephrase text to better match the terms, expressions, and cultural nuances of your locale.
Edit and adjust AI-generated summaries to enhance clarity, readability, and effectiveness in capturing key points and overall sentiment.
Ensure consistency across all summaries while following the provided content guidelines.
qualifications: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) proficiency (C1 or higher) in reading, writing, and comprehension, ensuring effective communication
Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in a related field.
Advanced writing skills and ability to synthesize and summarize complex information.
University degree in a relevant subject matter specialty (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Linguistics).
Proficiency in applying complex rules related to writing structure, content, and perspective.
Competence in researching, validating, and editing content for accuracy and reliability.
Knowledge of safety protocols and considerations in AI data delivery.
